address.grain: one source address identifier per dataset version

parcel.grain: one source parcel polygon per dataset version

urban_tree.grain: one mapped tree point per dataset version

named_tree_inventory.grain: one source-labelled council inventory tree per dataset version

weather_observation.grain: one weather station observation at one timestamp

heat_observation.grain: one spatial heat observation feature or summary for one observation date

vegetation_observation.grain: one vegetation feature or summary for one observation date

canopy_snapshot_feature.grain: one observed canopy polygon in one City of Melbourne snapshot

metropolitan_vegetation_change_feature.grain: one 2016 ABS Mesh Block-based polygon with 2014-to-2018 vegetation percentage-point change

plant_trait_observation.grain: one selected AusTraits observation row in one release

urban_tree_growth_observation.grain: one tree-ring measurement for one study tree and within-tree source sequence

urban_tree_growth_climate.grain: one distinct published climate-value variant for one city-year

cost_estimate.grain: one greening option, tree type where applicable, context, unit and validity period
